name: Kernels-to-Code Kernel — Stub Inventory → Bracketed Subagent Dispatch → Per-Stub Oracle-Gate → Journal
title_zh: 每个待办卡一个验收门，不达标不派活
tagline_zh: 把零散 stub 变成带验收标准的子代理任务，每步过 oracle 才放行，日志留痕。适合拆解模糊需求时。
tagline_en: Turn vague stubs into gated subagent tasks—each step must pass an oracle before dispatch, with full journaling.
desc_en: JSON Effect Scripting Language — a workflow engine on Effect-TS
why_zh: 不是简单列清单，而是给每个 stub 配一个可执行的验收谓词。
why_en: Not just a checklist—each stub carries an executable acceptance predicate, so subagent output must pass the oracle before.
limit_zh: 只认 JSON 格式的 stub 清单，且需预置 oracle 函数（本地或可调用 API）。不处理自然语言任务描述。
limit_en: Requires JSON stub list and preconfigured oracle functions (local or callable API). No natural-language task specs. Output ends at oracle-passed.
title_en: Per-stub oracle gate: no pass, no dispatch
